bio.text: Todd Lakey represents Idaho Senate District 23, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Nampa as the legislator's city.
The directory biography says Lakey holds a B.S. in international business from Brigham Young University and a law degree from Lewis and Clark Northwestern School of Law.
It lists service as a Canyon County deputy prosecutor from 1993 to 1999 and as a Canyon County commissioner from 1999 to 2004, and says Lakey is a retired U.S. Army Reserve officer.
